name: DS Five Points substation failure
description: DS-2 Five Points (simulated) trips. Its three radial feeders lose supply; normally-open ties to Centennial, Capitol and Peachtree Center can only pick up part of the load, and the outage cascades into water pumping, telecom, signals and MARTA.

name: Excavation strike on Marietta St duct bank
description: A contractor strikes the shared Marietta St duct bank between Broad St and Spring St, cutting every cable it hosts at once: a Five Points power feeder and the west fibre ring (common-cause failure).

scenario.name: Excavation strike on Marietta St duct bank

name: Transmission main break on Decatur St
description: A transmission water main ruptures on Decatur St east of Five Points; crews must close isolation valves, cutting supply to part of the low-pressure grid.

scenario.name: Transmission main break on Decatur St

name: 56 Marietta St carrier hotel outage
description: The core interconnection facility at 56 Marietta St (real building; modelled connections simulated) goes dark. Dual-homed rings fail over to the east core; single-homed sites may not.

name: Five Points road closures
description: Emergency closure of Peachtree St, Marietta St and Edgewood Ave where they meet at Five Points; traffic detours around the core.

name: Loss of TS-South bulk supply
description: The TS-South 115 kV bulk supply point (simulated) is lost. Its substations shift onto alternate transmission lines that were never sized to carry their full load.
